Our story

Harbour Lane began in a spare room above a chandlery, with one mediator and a kettle. Ten years on we are a small team who still believe most disagreements end better at a table than in a courtroom.

Every mediator is accredited by the (fictional) Westshire Mediation Council and works to its code of practice. We are independent: we don't take sides, and we don't give legal advice.

The team

  • Alex Morgan — founder and family mediator.
  • Sam Patel — workplace and community mediator.
